prediction.counterargument: Chelsea has roughly 184.2k home money and key attacking/leadership players returned to availability, so the draw thesis has a substantial football and market counterweight.
prediction.rationale: Chelsea–Bournemouth Draw has the deepest and cleanest price-compression path in the set: roughly 22.9k selected money in a 240.7k 1X2 market and 4.50→4.00 over 24h with continued late compression. Stage 2 only partially confirmed it because Chelsea regained Palmer, João Pedro and Reece James and still carries the dominant home-side money; that is meaningful counterevidence, so the case remains watch quality rather than a formal bet.
